projects.title: Command-Line Text Utility
bullets: Implemented a small command-line text utility in C with explicit memory handling as a contribution to a team course project.
Documented program structure and test cases, checked array bounds and error paths, and used Git for the project.

projects.title: Equipment Inventory Queries
bullets: Wrote SQL queries in SQLite to join and aggregate sample equipment inventory records for an individual course project.
Documented the equipment inventory schema and example queries, and checked missing values and duplicate records.
